meta.prompt: Show the change you want to make to my config.yaml as a diff I can review, in three separate hunks with line numbers, removed lines red and added lines green in a monospace font. Hunk 1 (Server port, lines 4 to 5): -port: 8080 +port: 9090. Hunk 2 (Logging, lines 12 to 15): -level: debug -file: /tmp/app.log +level: warn +file: /var/log/app.log. Hunk 3 (Cache, lines 20 to 22): +enabled: true +ttl: 300. Keep and Discard buttons on each hunk, a count of how many are decided and how many kept, and an Apply button that only works once all three are decided; after Apply the card says how many hunks were kept and how many discarded.
meta.text:
Using DiffHunk components with a decided-state variable per hunk; Apply is enabled only when all three are decided. The notation is written in the format given, starting with state declarations.

state h1=""
state h2=""
state h3=""
state applied=false
let decided = (h1!="" ? 1 : 0) + (h2!="" ? 1 : 0) + (h3!="" ? 1 : 0)
let kept = (h1=="keep" ? 1 : 0) + (h2=="keep" ? 1 : 0) + (h3=="keep" ? 1 : 0)
let discarded = decided - kept
Card gap:12 w:390
  Text.sectionTitle "config.yaml"
  Text.muted "{decided} of 3 decided, {kept} kept"
  if applied
    Receipt "Changes applied" "{kept} kept, {discarded} discarded" tone:good icon:"check_circle"
  if !applied
    DiffHunk "Server port" "@@ -4,2 +4,2 @@" =h1 start:4 lines:["-port: 8080","+port: 9090"]
    DiffHunk "Logging" "@@ -12,4 +12,4 @@" =h2 start:12 lines:["-level: debug","-file: /tmp/app.log","+level: warn","+file: /var/log/app.log"]
    DiffHunk "Cache" "@@ -20,3 +20,5 @@" =h3 start:20 lines:["+enabled: true","+ttl: 300"]
    ActionButton "Apply" primary icon:"done_all" enabled:{decided==3} -> applied=true
